description: A mail thread, found by any Message-ID in it, oldest first. Each message: from, to, cc, date, message_id, decoded body text (by default the author's own words: quoted replies, signature and inline patch removed; full_text=true for the whole decoded text; never raw MIME), attachments [{index, filename, content_type, size}] and has_patch. Paged: 20 messages per call (limit max 500; offset/next_offset/has_more); bodies capped at max_body_chars (default 4000; 0 = no cap; body_truncated marks a cut). include_bodies=false gives a cheap outline. Finds the list itself unless inbox is given. Cite as https://postgr.es/m/<message_id>.

full_text.description: Whole decoded text of each message, quotes included (default false: own words only).

inbox.description: Mailing list name, e.g. pgsql-general. Defaults to pgsql-hackers when omitted. Aliases: list, inbox_name.

include_bodies.description: Include message bodies (default true). false returns an outline: headers only.

max_body_chars.description: Cap each body at this many characters (default 4000; 0 = no cap).

message_id.description: Message-ID of any message in the thread, or a message URL (postgr.es/m/..., postgresql.org/message-id/..., pg.ddx.io/m/...)

offset.description: Skip this many messages; use next_offset from the previous page.

name: get_thread
